$comment: THE CLASSIFIER CORPUS. Read by BOTH implementations — src/php/Core and, later, src/phorj/core.
This file is the ground truth for the tenure classifier and is listed in BLAST-RADIUS.md as
stateful data that must not be casually removed or relabelled. CLAUDE.md: 'Never weaken a
classifier test to make a change pass. If a fixture goes red, the classifier regressed.'
PROVENANCE IS HONEST AND MACHINE-CHECKED. spec/PROJECT_BRIEF.md §4 asks for >=30 *real* listing
texts. Real texts cannot be captured until a source endpoint or a browser session exists (blocked
on U3 — the DevTools cURL captures). So every entry declares provenance: 'synthetic' texts are
hand-written French listing prose modelled on how these landlords actually word their pages;
'captured' entries are frozen from a real payload and scrubbed. The suite asserts the declared
synthetic/captured counts match reality, so the gap stays visible as data rather than as a comment.
id           stable identifier; never renumber, only append
source       the SourceProfile this listing arrived from
expect.tenure / expect.outcome   the hand label — the thing under test
why          why a human labelled it that way; the record for a future relabelling argument

icf_novedis.name: icf_novedis
icf_novedis.$why: FLIPPED to true on 2026-08-06 after review. CLAUDE.md's reviewer charter names ICF among the landlords that publish social AND intermediate stock. Novedis is genuinely ICF Habitat's non-social arm, so `false` is defensible for a Novedis-only endpoint and wrong for the group portal — and nothing in this repo yet says which the adapter will target, because config/sources.yaml does not exist. mixed_tenure is the single flag that disarms the fail-closed rule, so it takes the safe value until that is decided. Tracked as an open question.

cases.title: T4 avec plus de 3 chambres - Sartrouville
cases.description: Grand appartement offrant plus de rangements que la moyenne.
cases.why: THE PLUS TRAP, case 1. 'plus' is one of the commonest French words. A naive substring match classifies this In'li flat as PLUS social housing and rejects it. Nothing arrives, and the user concludes the market is quiet. Only the source default may fire here.

cases.title: T3 Houilles
cases.description: Disponible au plus tard le 1er septembre. Le sejour est plus lumineux que sur les photos.
cases.why: THE PLUS TRAP, case 2 — 'au plus tard' and 'plus lumineux' in one text.

cases.title: APPARTEMENT T3 LUMINEUX - PLUS DE 70 M2
cases.description: BIEN RARE, PLUS DE RANGEMENTS QUE LA MOYENNE.
cases.why: THE PLUS TRAP, case 3 and the nastiest. The title is SHOUTED, so 'uppercase PLUS' alone cannot be the social test — it must also be in a financing context. An all-caps portal title must not be read as a financing label.

cases.title: LOGEMENT PLUS GRAND - T4 CHATOU
cases.description: LOGEMENT PLUS SPACIEUX QUE LA MOYENNE, PLUS LUMINEUX AUSSI.
cases.why: FOUND BY SABOTAGE-CHECK, 2026-08-06. trap-003 does not exercise the comparative suppression at all: it fails the collocation test first, so the classifier never reaches the second condition. THIS one passes collocation — uppercase PLUS immediately after 'LOGEMENT' — and is stopped only by the comparative that follows. Deleting the suppression left the suite green until this fixture existed, and a shouted 'LOGEMENT PLUS GRAND' is an ordinary portal title.

cases.title: T3 Cergy
cases.description: Logement PLUS. Plus grand que la moyenne du quartier.
cases.why: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SAME COIN, and the dangerous direction. One text carries a genuine financing label AND an unrelated adverb. A document-level suppression check would see 'some occurrence is adverbial' and drop the real social signal, letting a PLUS listing reach a notification. The guard is therefore evaluated per occurrence, not per document.

cases.title: T3 Plaine de Versailles
cases.description: Cadre plaisant, vue degagee sur la plaine. Un vrai plaisir au quotidien.
cases.why: THE PLAI TRAP. As a bare substring 'plai' matches plaine, plaisant and plaisir. Word boundaries are mandatory.

cases.title: T2 Bezons
cases.description: Un surplus de charges est possible en hiver.
cases.why: 'surplus' contains 'plus'. Word boundaries again, from the other side.

cases.title: T4 CROISSY-SUR-SEINE - 3 CHAMBRES, PLUS UN BUREAU
cases.description: TROIS CHAMBRES, PLUS UN BUREAU FERME ET UNE BUANDERIE.
cases.why: FOUND BY SABOTAGE-CHECK, 2026-08-06, and it took two attempts to write correctly. Every other 'plus' trap here is followed by a comparative ('plus de', 'plus tard', 'plus lumineux'), so the comparative suppression alone caught all of them and the collocation test could be deleted with the suite staying green. This one has no comparative to fall back on — 'PLUS' is followed by 'UN'. It must also be SHOUTED: uppercase is enforced by the acronym pattern itself, so a lowercase 'plus' never reaches the collocation test at all, and a lowercase version of this fixture proves nothing. An all-caps portal title with 'PLUS UN BUREAU' is ordinary, and only the collocation test stands between it and a social-housing classification.

cases.title: T2 Triel-sur-Seine

cases.title: T3 Andresy
cases.description: Logement intermediaire : aucun numero unique d'enregistrement n'est requis, ce n'est pas un logement social.
cases.why: HONEST LIMIT, DELIBERATELY LABELLED. The text is genuinely LLI and says so twice, but it also contains the strings 'numero unique d'enregistrement' and 'logement social' inside negations. The classifier does not do negation parsing, so the conflict rule fires and this lands in the digest. That is the CORRECT behaviour under a fail-closed policy: a false DIGEST costs one manual glance, a false MATCH costs a wasted application. If negation handling is added later, this label changes deliberately, with the reasoning in the commit message.

cases.title: T3 Cergy
cases.description: Logement PLAI, sous conditions de ressources tres sociales.
cases.why: THE CONFLICT RULE, and the reason it exists. The ladder alone keeps LLI at 0.97 and notifies. An eligible verdict contradicted by an excluded-tenure signal must collapse to UNKNOWN instead. It does not assert the flat is social — it withholds.

cases.title: T2 Eragny
cases.description: Demande via numero unique d'enregistrement.
cases.why: Same rule with the contradiction coming from a tier-3 procedural tell rather than a label.

cases.title: T3 Argenteuil
cases.description: Logement intermediaire, loyer plafonne.
cases.why: THE ASYMMETRY, and it is deliberate. Mirror image of conflict-001, opposite result: an EXCLUDED verdict contradicted by an eligible signal stays excluded and is rejected. Softening an exclusion is the one direction that costs the user a wasted application, so the rule only ever works one way.

cases.title: T3 Sarcelles
cases.description: Logement PLUS ou PLAI selon les ressources.
cases.why: Two excluded tenures at the same tier. Which one wins does not matter to the user — both reject — so the tie-break is fixed and deterministic rather than clever.

cases.description: Appartement 3 pieces, 65 m2, parking.
cases.why: THE FAIL-CLOSED RULE, verbatim from CLAUDE.md §1: confidence < 0.6 AND a mixed source => UNKNOWN => digest. CDC Habitat declares no default tenure, so nothing fires at all.

cases.title: T3 Pontoise
cases.description: Appartement 3 pieces.
cases.why: PLI (Pret Locatif Intermediaire) is the pre-2014 intermediate scheme. It is genuinely NOT social — but it is not in the glossary and Q4 did not rule on it, so guessing 'intermediate, therefore match' would decide a product question in code. UNKNOWN routes it to the 'à vérifier' digest where a human decides. Raised as an open question.
A broken parser producing empty text must not produce a match. This is hard rule 2 and 3 territory: silent breakage must not look like a clean result.

cases.title: T3 Poissy
cases.description: Appartement 3 pieces, 70 m2.
cases.why: FOUND BY SABOTAGE-CHECK, 2026-08-06. A source declared non-mixed but given no default_tenure produces no signal at all, so the verdict is UNKNOWN. The routing branch for a source declared non-mixed would otherwise let it through. Only the explicit undetermined-tenure arm in route() stops such a listing from being notified, and until this fixture existed that arm could be removed with the suite staying green. It is a config shape nobody would write on purpose, which is exactly why it needs a fixture.

cases.title: T3 Cergy
cases.description: Appartement 3 pieces.
cases.why: An empty structured field is an ABSENT signal, not a tier-1 verdict. If an empty string were treated as a match on the field, tier 1 would fire on every listing from a source that emits the key unconditionally.

cases.title: T3 Éragny
cases.description: Logement intermédiaire proposé par le bailleur.
cases.why: HONEST LIMIT. HTML entities are the ADAPTER's job to decode, not the classifier's — a classifier that decodes entities hides a broken adapter. UPDATED 2026-08-06: the label is unchanged but the mechanism is no longer accidental. Undecoded entities are now treated as evidence that the ADAPTER stopped short, so the classifier refuses the text and says so, instead of matching whatever labels happened to survive. See case-006 for why that matters.

cases.title: T3 Cergy
cases.description: Ce logement social a loyer intermediaire.
cases.why: THE DANGEROUS HALF OF case-005's LIMIT, added 2026-08-06 after review. case-005 freezes the undecoded-entity limitation on a text where the entity breaks an LLI label, so the result digests and the limit costs nothing. Here the separator breaks the SOCIAL label while an intermediate label survives — the direction that does not fail safe. A corpus should carry the dangerous half of its own documented limit, not only the comfortable one.

cases.title: T3 Argenteuil
cases.description: Location directe par le bailleur, sans commission d'agence.
cases.why: P0 REGRESSION GUARD (review, 2026-08-06). A bare 'sans commission' was a tier-3 intermediate tell. In the wild that string is almost always 'sans commission d'agence' — a FEE disclaimer that says nothing about how the flat is allocated, and which bailleurs sociaux advertise too. Tier 3 clears the floor unaided, so this exact sentence turned a fail-closed digest into a notification. Only the two literals carrying the ATTRIBUTION sense are tells now.

cases.title: Logement conventionné
cases.description: Logement libre au 1er août 2026. T3 de 65 m².
cases.why: P0 REGRESSION GUARD (review, 2026-08-06), and the worst defect found in this module. 'logement libre' was in the label table as tenure LIBRE; it is not a tenure term at all but the standard French VACANCY phrase. It fired tier 2 at 90 on a move-in date, and the spurious LIBRE then satisfied the conventionné exception — which tested isEligible() rather than 'is an intermediate label'. Result: a listing whose own TITLE reads 'Logement conventionné' reached MATCH, with the word absent from its reasons. A §1 breach via two independently reasonable-looking table entries.

cases.title: T3 Herblay
cases.description: Logement conventionne, loyer plafonne.
cases.why: Found by review 2026-08-06. The conventionne exception looked at tier-2 labels only, so LLI declared through a STRUCTURED FIELD — the strongest evidence the ladder has — did not count as 'explicitly labelled intermediate', while the weaker text label did. Genuine LLI stock digested when its evidence arrived through the best channel. Fail-closed, so not a breach, but inconsistent with the ladder it claims to implement.

cases.title: T2 Domont
cases.description: Logement conventionne, loyer libre.
cases.why: THE EXCEPTION IS FOR INTERMEDIATE LABELS ONLY, and this is the fixture that says so. CLAUDE.md's glossary excuses conventionne when the listing is 'explicitly labelled intermediate' — LIBRE is not intermediate, it is market rate, so a LIBRE label must NOT disarm the exclusion. Without this case the drop-rule could be widened from '=== LLI' back to 'isEligible()' with the suite staying green, which is exactly how the P0 of 2026-08-06 was built: a spurious LIBRE signal satisfied the exception and a conventionne listing reached MATCH. The two labels here genuinely contradict each other (subsidised vs market rate), so withholding is also the honest reading.

cases.title: LOGEMENT PLUS MODERNE - T3 CHATOU
cases.description: BIEN RENOVE, PROCHE COMMERCES.
cases.why: Found by review 2026-08-06. The collocation guard suppressed adverbial PLUS via a denylist of French adjectives, so any adjective NOT on the list — moderne, confortable, economique, agreable, ensoleille — turned an emphatic title into tenure PLUS and a silent REJECT. A denylist of French adjectives cannot be completed. The guard now asks the closed question instead: does a financing label END the phrase (punctuation, end of text, another acronym)? If a word follows and it is a known comparative, it was the adverb; if a word follows and it is anything else, it is genuinely indecidable and lands here — visible in the digest rather than silently dropped OR silently matched.

cases.title: T3 - LLI
cases.description: Un numéro unique d'enregistrement est exigé pour toute demande.
cases.why: Found by review 2026-08-06. The fold tables carry PRECOMPOSED accented codepoints only, so text arriving NFD-decomposed ('e' + U+0301) was not folded and 'numéro unique d'enregistrement' never matched its literal — while the unaccented 'LLI' in the same listing still did. The social side vanished and the eligible side survived, which is the wrong direction to fail in. Combining marks are now stripped after the table: one line, locale-free, and portable to phorj. NOTE: this fixture's description is deliberately written with \u0301 escapes; do not 'tidy' it into precomposed characters, or it stops testing anything.

cases.title: T3 Taverny
cases.description: Appartement 3 pieces.
cases.why: Found by review 2026-08-06. Two structured fields each match at offset 0 of their own value, so the tie-break decides. resolve()'s comparator had its two strlen terms transposed, making the SHORTER evidence win — the opposite of its own docblock — so 'lli' (3) beat 'plai' (4) and an explicit PLAI field landed in the user-visible digest instead of REJECT. A phorj port written from the docblock would have disagreed with the PHP on exactly this input, which is the differential the shared corpus exists to expose.

cases.title: T4 Bezons
cases.description: Proche gare, residence calme.
cases.why: THE FAIL-CLOSED RULE APPLIED TO THE TENURE, not merely to the routing. spec §4 requires the verdict itself to become UNKNOWN below the floor on a mixed source; the code changed only the Outcome, leaving tenure LLI, so the two halves of the object disagreed and the next module written would have believed the eligible half. No fixture exercised the branch until this one, because every mixed source in the corpus declared no default. See also the ICF ruling in this file's source table.
